title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the metadata-service code-layer read out of protocol.ts into protocol-metadata-service-read.ts (#25467 cut 20)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 20 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–19 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317 and #26350. The claim is `6429678924`. The scope is the cut 20 proposal of the cut 19 report (`6428860550`), which the server seat approved in its dispatch order. The member passed the AST screen and moved unedited.

One `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` member moves unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-service-read.ts` (#23050 shape B):

- `readItemFromMetadataService`: the code-layer read through the `metadata` service. It reads one item, package-scoped (ADR-0048), and takes the service's diagnosis when the service gives one. It falls back to the singular/plural spelling. A stored object row's copy is not counted as a code layer (#23645).

`protocol.ts` loses 30 net lines (29,240 to 29,210). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `e2129cbf06` after cut 19 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `1cb285a797` and the merge of `main` `c19ad22f62` (`54aaeba31e`). That merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `953bab7a` at both ends.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 19 open PRs, three touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`. None names `readItemFromMetadataService`. Each was checked with `git merge-tree` against this branch's head (`54aaeba31e`) and against `origin/main` alone.

- **#26244** (draft, head `c33b95d89f`) is the only one that edits `protocol.ts`, at `:163` (imports) and `:23178`, far from `:9328`. Its merge-tree with this head conflicts in `protocol.ts` and `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`. Its merge-tree with `main` alone conflicts in the same two files. The `protocol.ts` conflict is the import-line conflict with cut 18's `ALL_CONVERSIONS` drop; #26317 spelled out the union resolution. This cut adds no conflict.
- **#26138** edits `protocol.*.test.ts` files. Its two conflicts (`scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json`, `types.json`) are likewise with `main` alone.
- **#26337** (head `2448c0035a`) edits three `protocol.*.test.ts` files. Its merge-tree with this head is clean.

No open PR edits the new module.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`)

The member passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** The body has no `new Error(` and no other error constructor, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. It has no `try`, no `catch` and no log line.

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `readItemFromMetadataService` | `:9328` | private async | 40 | 383 |

The proposal said 40.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–19 apply it)

- **The class keeps the member.** It keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Its body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 20]`.
- **Typing.** `MetadataServiceReadHost` types its one member as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['getServicesRegistry']`). The function types its `this` as `Pick<MetadataServiceReadHost, 'getServicesRegistry'>`. The stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof readItemFromMetadataService>`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk.** The walk covers property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked too. The body reads `getServicesRegistry` only, as `this.getServicesRegistry?.()`.
  - `getServicesRegistry` is an optional private FIELD holding the constructor-supplied callback, not a method. So it is handed over as a getter (`get getServicesRegistry() { return readGetServicesRegistry(); }`), and the body reads the protocol's field at call time.
  - An absent callback stays `undefined`, so the body's `?.()` short-circuits exactly as before.
  - This is the same hand-over `protocol-package-install.ts`, `protocol-record-reads.ts` and `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` already use for this field.
- **Every caller still calls the class method,** as the order asks for the `:9262` caller. There are four `this.readItemFromMetadataService(` sites in `protocol.ts` (`:9262`, `:11091`, `:11422`, `:18960` at base), and none changes.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over the body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canonicalMetaType` | exported function, `:484` | yes (23) | already exported; the new module imports it from `./protocol.js` at runtime, as `protocol-lock-state.ts` and `protocol-registry-materialize.ts` do |
| `isTenantAuthored` | the `@objectstack/metadata-core` import | yes | stays; the new module imports it from there too |
| `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` | the `@objectstack/spec/shared` import | yes | stay; imported from there too |

Nothing gains `export`, and no import of `protocol.ts` changes. The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (158 lines, and no entry changes file). The body has no `catch` and makes no engine call. Its reads go through the `metadata` service.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **This cut holds the bar, and raw identity does NOT hold**, for the reason below.

Base `e2129cbf06` and head `1cb285a797` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s. The readings were taken on the pre-merge tree, and the head readings again after merging `main` (head `54aaeba31e`, closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 119/119).

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `f7f9306ed46a5605c5e4c59bbc212a7d5288061760ec85d473d2f3047a836ba5` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs (the cut 12 normaliser). **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: base `a8f6adb6f9c56b8f441b7224ca8c4d43b84891bce0373446e1577a7884079dd8`, head `1b134685a474f83cfa85a743e49a811d607fcaeed53ae8856dd62db65ad132f5`. Both files are 776,660 bytes at each end.
  - The full raw diff is ONE line, `dist/index.d.ts:2448`, inside `getDiscovery()`'s inferred return type:
    ```
    <             status: "registered" | "available" | "degraded" | "unavailable" | "stub";
    >             status: "registered" | "degraded" | "available" | "unavailable" | "stub";
    ```
  - The same five members appear in a different order. This is the case the ruling's sorted-union bar exists for. `tsc` prints an inferred union in the order its literal types were first created in the program. Moving a body changes which file the checker visits first, which changes that order, and changes nothing else.
  - No signature, no member and no name moves. `readItemFromMetadataService` stays a `private NAME;` line.
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `9495894cdf5ce39b…` at base and `7be270d93afd5f1e…` at head.
  - The `.call(host` site of `readItemFromMetadataService` occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
  - `function readItemFromMetadataService(` appears 0 times at base and once at head.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `readItemFromMetadataService` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `c9acdc769a2b94ed…` (normalised `c1ebd3ff0d127a7e…`, which differs from the bar's `f7f9306e…`) and print `readItemFromMetadataService(type: string, name: string, packageId?: string): Promise<{ data: unknown; degraded: boolean; errors: string[]; }>;`. So the bar can see a change on this member.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither the moved function nor `MetadataServiceReadHost` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Body, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `e2129cbf06` against the head module:

```
readItemFromMetadataService: base tokens 383, head tokens 383, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=383 differ=0 members=1
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=300 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=1 other=[]
TOP base=248 head=249 byte-identical=248
```

**Negative control.** One token was changed in an in-memory copy of the head module: `?? SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` became `|| SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL`, one occurrence.

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-service-read.ts "?? SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL" -> "|| SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL"
readItemFromMetadataService: base tokens 383, head tokens 383, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
TOTAL tokens=383 differ=1 members=1
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 300 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. The stub sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 248 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +101 / −37 over 2 files, 138 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 180–230). `protocol-metadata-service-read.ts` has 94 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path (70 files) was grepped for the member name and for its body's text: `getDiagnosed`, `metadataService`, `isTenantAuthored`, `get('metadata')` and the plural/singular fallback. So were the test files in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/qa/`.

- **By path: none reads the moved body.** `protocol.metadata-store-outage.test.ts` matches `getDiagnosed` in comments. It does not read `protocol.ts` by path: it names the file in prose and drives the read through the protocol. It passes at both ends, in the package suite.
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed.** `packages/objectql/src/protocol-delete-boot-hydrated-object-heal.test.ts` names `readItemFromMetadataService` in its header and drives it through the delete door. Run at head after the full build: 1 file, 5 tests passed.
- **The `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.** No row points at `readItemFromMetadataService`. Carried forward from cut 19, two rows still hold `protocol.ts#member` evidence pointers whose quoted line has moved to a seam module:
  - `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19);
  - `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14).

  `check:liveness` checks only that the `#symbol` is named in the file, and both stubs keep it, so it passes. Re-pointing them is a `packages/spec/**` edit, outside this card.
- No hit in `docs/qa/`.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 at both ends. The decision-letter count is unchanged at 1,879. The citation count goes 59,279 → 59,280 and the file count 8,356 → 8,357. The `ADR-0048` comment in the body moves with it, and the new module's header names `ADR-0048` once more. The `protocol.ts` anchor's governing ADRs are all still referenced.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13926 → 13896, 13951 → 13921).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,748 at base and 3,750 at head. One of the +2 is the new file. The other is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `e2129cbf06`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register, so the PR is NOT governed. It has 138 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merge.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output. It covers the whole touched package, which has no `lint` script; these are the root `lint` script's flags.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock, and both gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The runs are on the pre-merge tree; the merge changed no file of the package.
  - Base `e2129cbf06`: 21,568 tests (21,549 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 270 files.
  - Head `1cb285a797`: 21,568 tests (21,549 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 270 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `e2129cbf06` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK. 1 anchored file is in the change set, 29 anchors were judged, and 0 were lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 51 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `54aaeba31e`, with no stale-tree warning; all 51 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 19. These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
